column1: # title: ENG-205 Sir Gawain Part 2 — 5 Q&A
What animal is hunted on each of the three days?
column2: Day 1 deer (hinds and does), day 2 a wild boar, and day 3 a fox (Reynard).

column1: How many kisses does Gawain return each evening?
column2: One kiss on day 1, two kisses on day 2, and three kisses on day 3.

column1: What does Lady Bertilak say Gawain is free to do on the first morning?
column2: Lady Bertilak tells Gawain he is free to have her all, do with her what he will, and she will come just as he calls.

column1: Why does Lady Bertilak say Gawain cannot be his name?
column2: Because a man so courtly could never linger long with a lady without craving a kiss as politeness requires.

column1: What does Gawain refuse to tell Bertilak after the first kiss?
column2: By what wit he won the kiss, and when and where, because that wasn't their pact.

column1: What proverb does Bertilak use before the third day?
column2: Think tomorrow third time throw best, after saying he has tested Gawain twice and found him truthful.

column1: What two gifts does Lady Bertilak offer on day 3 before Gawain accepts one?
column2: First a ring of rich red gold with a stunning stone, which Gawain refuses, then her green silk girdle.

column1: What does Lady Bertilak claim the green girdle can do?
column2: The body bound within it will be safe against anyone who seeks to strike him, and all the slyness on earth wouldn't see him slain.

column1: What promise about the girdle does Gawain make to Lady Bertilak?
column2: Gawain agrees not to whisper a word of the gift to her husband, so their words within those walls should stay.

column1: What does Gawain give Bertilak on the third evening, and what does he withhold?
column2: Gawain gives three kisses but withholds the green girdle he gained that day.

column1: What does Bertilak bring as his third-day winnings?
column2: Only a foul-stinking fox pelt, which he calls a miserable match for Gawain's three perfect kisses.

column1: How does Fitt III end for Gawain's schedule?
column2: Gawain says farewell, Bertilak assigns a servant to guide him to the Green Chapel, and Gawain lies thinking of the morning's destiny on New Year's Day.
